title: Pre-trip driver health check
what: A quick check of the driver before departure: blood pressure, pulse and sobriety. It is done before every trip.
why: For drivers of company vehicles, before every trip or shift.
tell_doctor: Whether you took any medicines, especially sedatives or allergy or cough medicine

prepare.title: Sleep
prepare.text: Get a good night's sleep before the trip.

prepare.title: Alcohol
prepare.text: Do not drink the day before. Even alcohol in the evening can still show on the device in the morning.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Some medicines slow your reaction. Tell the medic what you take, but do not stop on your own.

bring: Glasses, if you need them to drive
steps: The medic asks how you feel
Measures your blood pressure and pulse
Sometimes your reaction is tested or you are examined
If all is fine, the trip sheet is stamped
feel: If you are nervous, your blood pressure may be a bit higher. The medic will take that into account
after: With the stamp, you can start your trip
If you are not cleared, do not drive and tell your manager
If you feel unwell on the road, stop
red_flags: Pressing chest pain, sudden weakness or trouble speaking: stop and call your local emergency number

faq.q: What if my blood pressure is high?
faq.a: The medic may not clear you for the trip and may send you to a doctor. This is for your safety.

faq.q: Will the breathalyzer pick up mouthwash?
faq.a: Sometimes. Wait a little and take the test again. This is the usual practice.

reminders.text: Trip tomorrow. Get a good sleep and do not drink alcohol: the pre-trip check is in the morning.
